text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "The app moved to Fly.io on 28 May; the Vercel deployment noted on 14 Apr is no longer where it runs, and it cannot deploy to both as its platform."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The Node 20 runtime can still be in use on Fly.io; the hosting platform changing says nothing about the runtime version."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Whether the shipment tracking repo is open source has nothing to do with where the app is hosted."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The local dev server port is independent of the production hosting platform; both can be true."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The customs module being in scope for launch is a product decision unaffected by the deployment target."}]}
